intro: Your mom took a short quiz about how God wired you, and she'd love to see it from your side too. This isn't a test, and there are no right answers. Take it on your own and answer for you. It takes about 5 minutes. Your answers show next to hers, and it's normal if they don't match: you each see different sides of you.
instructions: Think about yourself over the past month. For each moment, pick the ONE answer that sounds most like you right now, even if more than one fits. There are no wrong answers: every choice is a strength.
frequency_stem: In the past month, how often do you...

scenarios.prompt: A free evening all to yourself. You are most likely to...

options.text: read, write, or work on an essay, story or blog
work on a strategy game, a coding project or a logic puzzle
draw, edit photos or video, or redo your space

scenarios.prompt: In a group (co-op class, youth group, a team), you shine when...

options.text: there is something physical to do: build, play, compete
there is music: worship team, choir or a band
you can lead, encourage, or pull the group together

scenarios.prompt: On a hike or camping trip, you...

options.text: like to hang back and have some quiet time alone
know, or want to know, the plants, birds and trees
end up in deep talks about God, creation or purpose

scenarios.prompt: When you are stressed, you usually...

options.text: talk it out, or write it down
work it off: exercise, build, cook or fix something
pull back for a while to think it through alone

scenarios.prompt: Planning a family trip, you are the one who...

options.text: builds the schedule, the budget or the packing list
makes the playlist for the drive
finds the trails, parks, farms or wildlife to see

scenarios.prompt: At church or youth group, you are most drawn to...

options.text: the creative side: slides, stage design, photos or art
the people: mentoring younger kids or talking with adults
the teaching, and wrestling with hard questions afterward

scenarios.prompt: Late at night, you are most likely to...

options.text: be reading, writing, or deep in a good story
be listening to, playing, or writing music
want to talk about faith, meaning, or what is right

scenarios.prompt: In a group project, you naturally...

options.text: set up the plan, the numbers or the system
keep everyone working together and feeling heard
take one piece and do it on your own

scenarios.prompt: Your dream summer job or project would be...

options.text: something creative: design, photos or decorating
something hands-on: building, repairing, cooking or a trade
something outdoors: a farm, a vet clinic or a park

scenarios.prompt: With friends, you are usually the one who...

options.text: tells the stories everyone remembers
notices who is left out and pulls them in
gets everyone outside: hiking, fishing or caring for animals

scenarios.prompt: Faced with a hard problem, you...

options.text: break it down logically, step by step
try things with your hands until something works
ask what the right thing to do is, and why

scenarios.prompt: Given an hour alone, you are most likely to...

options.text: sketch, design, or build something detailed
practice an instrument, sing, or write a song
journal, reflect, or set goals for yourself

frequency.text: read, write, or play with words for fun
enjoy puzzles, numbers, logic, or figuring out how things work
draw, design, or picture how something will look before making it
build, fix, cook, or make things with your hands
sing, play music, or notice sounds and rhythms
help, lead, or encourage the people around you
want time alone to think or set your own goals
care for or explore plants, animals and the outdoors
ask big questions about God, purpose, or right and wrong
